## What Is Loopy Media?

Loopy Media is a premium digital marketing agency based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. It specialises in helping local businesses — clinics, hospitals, restaurants, cafes, gyms, educational institutes, startups, and service-based businesses — grow their digital presence, generate leads, and increase revenue through websites, social media, branding, and performance marketing.

---

## Services

1. Website Design & Development
2. Social Media Management
3. Branding & Visual Identity
4. Content Creation (Reels, Graphics, Copy)
5. Digital Marketing & Paid Ads (Meta Ads, Google Ads)
6. Influencer Marketing

## PRICING (Current — June 2026)

### WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT PLANS

| Plan | Price | Best For |
|------|-------|----------|
| Starter Website | ₹799/month | Small businesses & startups |
| Business Website | ₹1,499/month ⭐ Most Popular | Clinics, cafes, gyms, local businesses |
| Growth Website | ₹2,999/month | Hospitals & growing businesses |

**Starter Website (₹799/month):** 5 pages, mobile responsive, contact form, WhatsApp integration, basic SEO, free hosting & maintenance, monthly updates.

**Business Website (₹1,499/month — Most Popular):** Everything in Starter + up to 10 pages, custom design, Google Maps integration, blog section, speed optimization, advanced SEO, monthly content updates. Best for clinics, cafes, gyms, local businesses.

**Growth Website (₹2,999/month):** Everything in Business + booking/appointment system, lead capture funnels, CRM integration, advanced analytics, landing pages, priority support, monthly optimization. Best for hospitals and growing businesses.

**Note:** All website plans include maintenance, security updates, hosting support, and ongoing technical assistance. Minimum 12-month commitment required.

## FAQ

**Q: What is the cheapest website plan?**
A: Starter Website at ₹799/month — 5 pages, mobile responsive, WhatsApp integration, free hosting, monthly updates.

**Q: What is the most popular plan?**
A: The Business Website (₹1,499/month) for websites, Growth Social (₹4,999/month) for social media, Growth Marketing (₹9,999/month) for ads, and Complete Growth Bundle (₹9,999/month) for all-in-one.

**Q: Is there a contract for social media plans?**
A: No — social media and marketing plans are month-to-month. Website plans require a minimum 12-month commitment.

**Q: Does the price include ad spend?**
A: No. The digital marketing plan fee covers management only. Ad spend (Meta/Google budget) is billed separately.

**Q: Is the free audit really free?**
A: Yes — 100% free, no obligation. Covers Instagram, website, and brand positioning. DM "GROW" on Instagram or contact via WhatsApp.

**Q: Do you work outside Ahmedabad?**
A: Yes — clients across India and internationally are served digitally.
